I checked all five messages the app shows when it rejects a file against F2 step 4. Each one fell short, mostly because it didn't tell the customer what to do next. I've rewritten them in `app/backup.js`. **Nothing is committed and there's no pull request yet.** The repo rules don't let me commit or push, and the plan has to be updated first (see below).

**Check:** `bash scripts/check.sh` passes.
```

```
(CLAUDE.md says a healthy run shows 44 tests, but the last commit has 38 and I added 1, so that number in CLAUDE.md is out of date.)

## The five messages

| Key / plan row | What was missing | Proposed wording |
|---|---|---|
| `emptyFile` / M8 | what to do next; didn't say the list is unchanged | File này không có việc nào, nên chưa nhập được. Danh sách của bạn vẫn giữ nguyên. Hãy chọn file sao lưu khác. |
| `notBackup` / M9 | what to do next | File này không phải file sao lưu của app, nên chưa nhập được. Danh sách của bạn vẫn giữ nguyên. Hãy chọn file có tên bắt đầu bằng "todo-sao-luu-". |
| `badTodo` / M10 | what to do next | File sao lưu có việc bị lỗi, nên chưa nhập được việc nào. Danh sách của bạn vẫn giữ nguyên. Hãy chọn file sao lưu khác. |
| `fileTooBig` / M11 | what to do next | File này quá lớn, nên chưa nhập được. Danh sách của bạn vẫn giữ nguyên. Hãy chọn file sao lưu khác. |
| `cannotReadFile` / M14 | why it failed; didn't say the list is unchanged | Không mở được file này, có thể file đã bị chuyển đi hoặc xoá. Danh sách của bạn vẫn giữ nguyên. Hãy chọn lại file. |

The confirmation questions, the "đang đọc" message and the save-failed message (F2 step 8 / F3) aren't file rejections, so I left them alone.

## Test changes
- **Updated:** `tests/backup.test.js` had the exact old text of M8 and M11, so I changed those two checks to the new text.
- **Added:** one test that checks all five messages say why the file was rejected, that the list is unchanged, and end with a "Hãy …" next step.

## Before this can be committed
- **The accepted plan must be updated by a person.** The plan's wording table quotes all five messages word for word (`plan/2026-10-19-khach-khong-mat-viec.md`, rows M8–M11 and M14). This change departs from that plan, so someone has to update those rows in the same commit; the pre-commit hook checks this. I haven't edited the plan.
- **Linh and Thảo approved some of the old text.** M8 was agreed by Thảo and Linh, and M11 is Linh's own wording. I kept their sentences unchanged at the start and only added to the end, but Linh should confirm the additions.

## Questions for Linh
- **M9:** is the file-name hint ("todo-sao-luu-") useful to customers, or too close to a technical detail under rule U4?
- **M14:** "có thể file đã bị chuyển đi hoặc xoá" is my best guess at the usual cause. The browser doesn't tell the app why it couldn't open the file.
- **M10 and M11:** "Hãy chọn file sao lưu khác" is honest but thin. If the customer has no other backup, there isn't a real next step. An app backup over 1 MB is already flagged when it's saved (M2).
